DEPARTMENT OF ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION
METROPOLITAN UNIVERSITY OF COMPUTING
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Rahul Deshmukh, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2012-2015) at Metropolitan University of Computing.

During this tenure, Rahul Deshmukh demonstrated exceptional mastery in Python, PyTorch, Distributed Systems, Kubernetes. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Edge Devices', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Rahul Deshmukh displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Rahul Deshmukh among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Prof. Elena Rostova
Distinguished Professor
Robotics & Automation
Metropolitan University of Computing
Email: prof..elena.rostova@metropolit.edu
